summary: The project's evidence base rests on four layers. (1) CORRELATIONAL HEADLINE: motion-space (optical-flow) source→benchmark distances predict transfer rankings of synthetic training sources far better than matched DINO appearance distances, across three CV regimes (LOTO held-source, LOBO held-benchmark, JOINT both held). The headline estimand is the paired motion-minus-appearance gap under generator-family cluster bootstrap (gap +0.364 to +0.754, P(gap>0) >= 0.993 in all regimes), defended by shuffle nulls, 6-way L-mechanism invariance, density controls, leave-one-generator-family-out (motion rho stays +0.219 to +0.518 under every drop), and dense/sparse stratification. (2) CEILING FRAMING: the modest motion rho ~= 0.45 is reframed as ~78% of an inter-variant reproducibility ceiling (0.454/0.584 pooled) and 77%/79%/57% of a held-architecture consensus (LOTO/LOBO/JOINT); the win-rate-vs-gap analysis shows motion ranks source pairs about as well as re-training the model does at every gap size. The consistency analysis decomposes everything into level + source_quality + motion_match + noise: a seed-free camera-vs-object crossover (camera-dominant source wins K2012 by +6.99 FF / +2.67 TT; object-dominant wins FlyingThings by -5.46 FF / -3.65 TT, replicating across both training regimes) proves a genuine source-by-benchmark interaction, and double-demeaning shows the notorious appearance "anti-correlation" (+0.249 wrong-signed) is a source-quality confound that collapses to -0.175 once source identity is removed. (3) REGIME-DIRECTION LAW (newest, paper-restructuring): which DIRECTION of directed motion coverage predicts transfer flips with training regime — from-scratch models are precision-bound (train->target distance, a->b: catspp F/F +0.600) while pretrained models are recall-bound (target->train, b->a: glunet T/T +0.719); a fit-free one-bit regime rule scores +0.498 mean within-context Spearman, ~= the inter-variant ceiling 0.528 (fraction 0.99), beats every fitted ridge/pooling structure, was adversarially verified (exact permutation p=0.0286, the design's floor), and PASSED its pre-registered out-of-sample test on the from-scratch kubric intervention grid (precision +0.621 > sym +0.096 > recall -0.125 with 5-seed-averaged distances); a DINO control shows no flip in appearance space. (4) INTERVENTIONAL STUDY (kubric/SDF renders): the practical loop "search synthetic-motion parameters theta with TPE against the predictor, materialize the winner, train, compare to prediction" is supposed to show the predictor can DESIGN data, not just analyze it. It is closed for KITTI (predicted margin +0.93 vs observed +0.87; trial76 97.78 vs anchor 96.91) and confirmed as an honest null on FlyingThings (predicted ~0; trained trial80 80.68 vs baseline 82.26 = -1.58); the kubric arm produced a 13-cell master table where trial19 (single frozen forward-dolly) beats movi_f on K2015 (96.12 vs 94.82 TT; 87.15 #1 from-scratch) and the TPE-designed synthetic_fractal is the strongest from-scratch source (94.43 K2015). FAILURES/INCONSISTENCIES are significant and well-documented: a Middlebury eval bug was CONFIRMED 2026-06-10 and Middlebury is now EXCLUDED from all canonical results — most Obsidian-note tables quoting Middlebury numbers predate this; the trial19 training set was discovered to be DEGENERATE (one frozen motion field x 5000 textures), which converted the "appearance is nearly free" -0.37 HQ->matte result into a frozen-set artifact (with real motion diversity the matte cost is -2.57 to -2.74 at TT and -3.7 to -10.8 from scratch); the predictor's known object-blindness made it wrongly predict the FT-recovered config would be a strong KITTI source; absolute-level calibration misses by ~4-19 PCK out of distribution and two leakage-clean calibration analyses returned NULL (ranking, not magnitude, is the deliverable); almost all intervention cells are single-seed with variant gaps at or below the +-0.4-1.9 seed-noise floor; and the from-scratch arm's fine K2015 ordering flips against motion distance and is attributed to seed noise plus a clean-supervision confound. Current state of the interventional arm: FF grid 10/10 complete, jitter (randomness-ladder) dataset and KITTI-fitted HQ/matte pairs still materializing, sdf Middlebury/FlyingThings TPE winners searched but never trained, and >=3-seed runs on the load-bearing crossover cells remain the decisive missing validation.
